description: Cancel the connected person's own order, under the same rules as the WaitApp website: free while the venue or a rider hasn't started; refused once the rider is collecting or has the food. A paid order is flagged for the venue to review a refund; refunds are never instant or automatic. If the connection is set to confirm each decision, the first call returns what would be cancelled and cancels nothing until a call with confirmed: true. With full control it cancels immediately (at most 3 a day).

confirmed.description: True records that the person agreed to cancel this order

orderCode.description: The order code returned when the order was placed, e.g. WA-K4M2

restaurantId.description: The venue the order was placed at (needed with orderCode if the person has the same code at two venues)

name: cancel_order
title: Cancel an order
